1949, November 26
The following is the faithful transcription of the hand-written original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY ROUTE 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
Nov. 26 - '49 Blessed be God. In all His designs.
God bless you Sister Mary Rose Francis.
We hope this find you improved and improving. However, we must be ready to face facts. Please pardon brevity, but your letter - rather your description of your trouble sounds like trouble which sooner Every sister - if she live long enough should expect. So in case those dizy spells continue do not be upset about but have a little patience and offer all for the intentions of the Sacred Heart.
1949, November 26
The following is the faithful transcription of the hand-written original message on the Seraphic Mass Association Certificate of Membership by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Ven. Sister Mary Rose Francis,
for speed health-improvement, God willing, and for holy quidance.
Emergency, special Membership November 26 - 1949 Hope this help someway. Fr. Solanus O. F.M. Cap.
